species.name: Crappie
why: Water 68°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 6–24 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 68°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 2–20 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
East wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
